description: DRAFT labels proposed by the AI assistant from the knowledge base documents (knowledge-base/cvs PDFs read with pdftotext, knowledge-base/projects and tech_stacks JSON), written BEFORE the matching system was run on these lines and without reading its stored answers. Not ground truth: every label is NEEDS_REVIEW until a person checks it in the sheet. Same policy as real_tenders.json (covered = a document clearly proves the line as written; partial = related evidence or an equivalent technology; missing = no document proves it; administrative lines are missing).
